scripts.start: pm2 delete api 2>/dev/null; pm2 start "NODE_OPTIONS='--dns-result-order=ipv4first' bun ." --name api -i 1 && pm2 save
scripts.start-6: pm2 delete api 2>/dev/null; pm2 start "NODE_OPTIONS='--dns-result-order=ipv6first' bun ." --name api -i 1 && pm2 save
scripts.gen-update: rm -rf node_modules bun.lock && curl -L https://github.com/GreenVGJR/api/tarball/main | tar -xz --strip-components=1 && bun install && bun update --latest && bun run gen && bun run start
